core_obligations: Prove the equivalence of factoring through a projective module and through a free one by quoting the characterisation of projective modules (proof lines 17726-17728).
Show that the sum of two maps factoring through P and P' factors through the direct sum, and that scalar multiples also factor, yielding the submodule statement (proof lines 17728-17732).
Show that if a map factors through P then so does any pre- or post-composition of it, which is the third part of the statement (proof lines 17732-17735).
proof_roadmap: Equivalence of projective and free factoring (proof lines 17726-17728).
Submodule statement via direct sums (proof lines 17728-17732).
difficulty_reason: The lemma establishes three elementary but load-bearing facts about maps that factor through projective modules: such factoring through a projective module is equivalent to factoring through a free module, the set of such maps is a submodule of the Hom module, and the property is stable under pre- and post-composition. The proof is a 10-line argument that quotes the equivalence of projective and free for the first part, uses that sums of maps factoring through two modules factor through their direct sum for the second, and constructs the composite factorisation for the third. Each of the three steps is written out explicitly.
